name: Capital Gain Format 4 Choice
definition: Choice between a standard code or proprietary code to specify the type of capital gain.

Code.name: Code
Code.definition: Specifies whether capital gain is in the scope of the European directive on taxation of savings income in the form of interest payments (Council Directive 2003/48/EC 3 June) for an income realised upon sale, a refund or redemption of shares and units etc.

Proprietary.name: Proprietary
Proprietary.definition: Proprietary identification of the type of capital gain.
